identity.name: Santos de Cartier

case.bezel: polished steel bezel with exposed screws

identity.one_liner: The medium-size version of the 2018 Santos relaunch, sharing the large model's quick-change bracelet system in a smaller case.

narrative.story: The medium Santos de Cartier shares its case architecture, exposed bezel screws, and tool-free quick-change bracelet system with the large model from the 2018 relaunch, scaled down to a 35.1mm case that fits a wider range of wrist sizes.
narrative.collector_notes: Medium and large Santos cases are not simply scaled versions of the same components; bracelets, buckles, and some case parts are not interchangeable between the two sizes.
